one_line: Anthropic-backed proofs advance mathematics, while major funding rounds, hardware developments, and regulatory investigations shape the AI industry.

themes.title: AI-assisted proofs tackle major mathematical problems
themes.text: An Anthropic mathematician and researchers published AI-aided proofs for the Riemann hypothesis and Navier-Stokes blowup, though the Riemann hypothesis claim lacks independent verification.

stories.headline: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved Riemann hypothesis with Claude
Researchers publish AI-aided Navier-Stokes blowup proof
Levent Alpöge reports discovering proof of Riemann Hypothesis with Claude

themes.title: Valuations climb amid major financial shifts
themes.text: Pragmatik Labs reached a $5 billion valuation, Cognition AI entered talks for a $75 billion valuation, and SoftBank explored a $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix. Meanwhile, Nvidia faced a U.S. SEC accounting investigation.

stories.headline: Pragmatik Labs reaches $5 billion valuation in new funding round
Cognition AI in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation
SoftBank explored a $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix
Nvidia faces U.S. SEC accounting investigation, sources say

themes.title: New models and speech tools launched
themes.text: Thinking Machines Lab released the Inkling 2 Mini open-weights model, Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4, and Mistral also introduced the Voxtral 3 speech models and voice agent SDK.

stories.headline: Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling 2 Mini open-weights model
Mistral launches public preview of Mistral Large 4
Mistral releases Voxtral 3 speech models and voice agent SDK
